text: From the re-review of 865f379e8 (names-and-deixis, APPROVE WITH FOLLOW-UPS): (3) PresenceClaim.key joins fields with | : , which ids may contain (IdRules bans only whitespace and control characters), so two distinct claims can tie and a stable sort keeps input order; fail-closed (a link is refused as foreign), rule 10 gap. Fix: sort on a field vector or the per-claim hashed digest fields. (4) PresenceClaim keeps coverage.bundle (short id), not full bundle identity; confirm two editions cannot share a short bundle id, or bind identity.
